approximation_notes: IV inverted from EUROPEAN Black-Scholes put (bisection) although SPY/QQQ options are American; acceptable for OTM short-dated index puts, biases IV/delta slightly.
Daily close used as the mark (mid proxy); measured half-spread x 2 legs x 2 directions + $1 x 4 fees charged on top.
Long wing requires only a bar on entry day (no n>=30 trade-count gate); the n>=30 gate applies to the short leg.
Profit-take exits fill at exactly 0.5 x credit; friction for that exit is priced off the trigger day's leg closes.
r = 0.043 fixed; continuous dividend yield q: SPY 0.012, QQQ 0.006.
Missing/limit-truncated data is skipped and counted, never interpolated: availability is measured only over entries whose fetched strikes could construct at least one vertical.

verdict.criterion_text: 验收:**允许交易的 regime 内合格 vertical 存在于 ≥60% 快照日** — i.e. a qualifying vertical must exist on >=60% of snapshot days WITHIN THE REGIMES THE SLEEVE IS ALLOWED TO TRADE.
verdict.why_not: NOT EVALUATED AS SPECIFIED: this replay carries no regime labels, so availability was measured UNCONDITIONALLY over all planned entry days. The criterion is conditional on the allowed regimes; an unconditional rate is neither the criterion nor a bound on it.
verdict.what_was_measured: UNCONDITIONAL availability of a qualifying vertical over the planned entry days, under one mark convention at a time.

data_adequate.definition: planned entries whose FETCHED strikes could construct at least one vertical

planned.definition: every planned (entry_date, symbol) pair, data gaps charged against availability

verdict.overall_verdict: CRITERION NOT EVALUATED AS SPECIFIED (no regime labels). The unconditional rate FAILS the 60% floor on both denominators.

friction_comparison.note: execution_costs.friction_r proxies each leg's mark by net_credit (leg-mid-sum = 2 x net_credit), exact only at wing ratio 1/3. Compare wing_ratio_long_over_short against 1/3: the deployed model's spread leg is off by exactly leg_mid_sum_over_net_credit / 2 (>1 = understated).

availability.acceptance_criterion: >=60% of DATA-ADEQUATE entry days must have a qualifying vertical (revival plan M1-0.4). Entries whose option data was never fetched are excluded from the denominator and reported as data_coverage_rate instead. NOTE: the plan's own criterion is CONDITIONAL on the allowed regimes and is NOT what this number measures — see .verdict.

friction_under_calibration_file.note: execution_costs.friction_r proxies each leg's mark by net_credit (leg-mid-sum = 2 x net_credit), exact only at wing ratio 1/3. Compare wing_ratio_long_over_short against 1/3: the deployed model's spread leg is off by exactly leg_mid_sum_over_net_credit / 2 (>1 = understated).

sensitivity.how_to_read: Each row is a full independent replay of the same data under one defensible convention change. Compare mean_r across the mark-* rows: the spread of that column IS the identification limit of daily trade-print aggregates.

mark-smile.note: PRIMARY — cross-leg consistent: both legs off ONE same-day IV curve

mark-close.note: DISCLOSED UPPER BOUND — last trade per leg; the credit inherits the full leg-vs-leg timing gap

liquidity-same-day.note: LOOK-AHEAD: screens on the entry day's own full-day trade count, which does not exist until the close

width-any.note: 'any' takes the narrowest width in WIDTHS whose credit clears the floor — the literal reading of the spec's 'width $5-10'
